header: What a person who has not signed in may see of an employee: the name (with Dr. or PhD where it applies) and the department, nothing else (my choice "C", 21 Nov 2026). The ticket number is half of every login, and a designation, a P.No., a contact hint or an executive's badge is for colleagues who have signed in. I do this on the SERVER, on the answer that is about to leave it, so no screen has to remember to hide anything: an employee card is cut down to an allow-list of fields (so a field added later stays hidden until you allow it here), and a table answer loses the columns that carry those details. Pure: it never changes what it is given, it returns a copy. Switched off (my decision, 22 Nov 2026): a visitor sees the same cards as a signed-in person, with the contacts masked, and a click on a masked mobile or e-mail opens the login window and, after the sign-in, reveals it (audited). The P.No. stays masked for everybody (it is also the first password). I kept this code ready: set VISITOR_CUT_ENABLED to true and the two search routes cut an answer for a visitor again.

symbols.name: VISITOR_CUT_ENABLED
doc: false = a visitor sees the full (masked) cards; true = a visitor sees name and department only. The two search routes read this.

symbols.name: CARD_FIELDS
doc: These are the only fields of an employee card that a visitor receives.

symbols.name: HIDDEN_COLUMN
doc: I hide a column of a table answer from a visitor when its key says it is one of these.

doc: Returns the same answer with every employee card cut down and the sensitive columns of every table taken out, anywhere in it.

behaviours: a card keeps the name, the Dr./PhD marks and the department (and its code)
a card loses the ticket, the P.No., the designation (and code), the discipline, the executive badge, the contact hints and the extra chips
a field added to the card later is hidden until it is allowed (an allow-list, not a deny-list)
every card anywhere in an answer is cut down
a table loses the ticket, designation and mobile columns (the headings and every row), and keeps name and department
the rest of the answer is unchanged (kind, text, totals) and the original object is not touched
things that are not employees or tables pass through (numbers, strings, null, nested arrays)
the open search route sends a visitor the cut-down cards, and a lookup by P.No., mobile or CUG needs a sign-in
the search route shapes every answer after it is made and before it leaves; the visitor cut applies only while it is switched on
the cut is switched off (the owner, 22 Nov 2026): a visitor gets the full cards, contacts masked, and a masked contact opens the login window; set VISITOR_CUT_ENABLED to bring the cut back
